content:
**Abraxodyne Chemical Complex** is an unmarked location appearing as part of The Trench in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Expeditions: The Pitt* update.

A location belonging to Abraxodyne Chemical. Several work memos were sent out regarding office pranks and policies. [1] [2] Neglected by Abraxodyne Chemical corporate, this facility was tasked with the research and development new chemical products, including PID-31148, also known as Industrial Grade Drain Cleaner. [3] [4] PID-31148 proved to be extremely caustic and toxic, causing the Pittsburgh Union Railroad to begin refusing to ship Abraxodyne's waste products out of the city, as the chemicals repeatedly ate through their train's containers. [5] After storing the waste chemicals in a warehouse in plastic barrels, Abraxodyne employee Edgar Clemmon began dumping the chemicals outside, polluting the area that would one day become known as The Trench.
